# KONDŌ

> KONDŌ (金堂, "Golden Hall") is a made-to-order clothing brand built around
> the practice of yoga. Garments are made from linen and ramie, produced only
> after a 50% deposit is paid, and delivered within 1–2 weeks. The brand has
> two collections: Yoga Drop and City Drop.

## Brand

- Name: KONDŌ
- Meaning: In Japanese Buddhism, KONDŌ (金堂) means "Golden Hall" — the
  central and most sacred space of a Buddhist temple, where Buddha statues
  are enshrined and important rituals are performed. It represents a sacred
  space of spiritual harmony, inner balance, and perfection.
- Materials: linen and ramie (natural, breathable, durable fibres).
- Business model: made to order only — nothing is kept in stock. Order with
  a 50% deposit; garments are ready in 1–2 weeks.
- Languages spoken by the team: Russian, Estonian, English.
- Contact: designs.alys@gmail.com / +372 583 76 982

## Collections

- Yoga Drop — clothing created for the practice of yoga. 4 pieces in the
  "Jasmin" line: Top Jasmin, Panties Jasmin, Long Sleeve Wrap Jasmin,
  Leggings Jasmin.
- City Drop — clothing created for the rhythm of everyday life. 6 pieces
  (names not finalized at time of writing; includes one dress).

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://kondo.ee/): brand story, fabric information,
  both collections, wash & care instructions, and the order form.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prices currently shown on the site are placeholders pending final pricing
  from the brand — treat them as provisional, not confirmed retail prices.
- All pieces are made to order and available exclusively by pre-order; there
  is no ready-to-ship stock.
